title: The supplier is published under article 49 Bis, which has no clearing to wait for
notes: The second SAT list, and it is not a second flavour of 69-B. Article 49 Bis, fraccion X publishes one outcome per oficio and publishes no clearing: there is no desvirtuado column to move into later. So a published taxpayer stays published, the buyer has thirty natural days from the DOF date to correct, and nothing in this product may report a 49 Bis taxpayer as cleared. The account and the amount are ordinary on purpose, exactly like the headline 69-B case: what is wrong is fiscal, not the payment.
